name: Memories of Green

start.dialog: Look at this place. Nothing but sand and rocks. Used to know a place... green. Full of life. Lost it. Looking for seeds. From before. Heard an old trader buried some near the oasis. Help me find 'em?
start.objective: Search the abandoned oasis for buried pre-cataclysm seeds

progress.dialog: The seeds... they'd be in a metal container. Rusted by now. But seeds can last... if you're lucky.
progress.objective: Dig at suspicious spots around the oasis

complete.dialog: ...You found 'em. These could grow. Could bring green back. Thanks. Here, take this. Heavy barrel for your gun-arm. Custom made. Hits harder than anything Dominion makes.

party_comments.kade: Bringing life back to the desert... that's worth fighting for.
party_comments.renna: Pre-cataclysm seeds are extremely valuable. Genetically diverse.
party_comments.suresh: Life finds a way. Even here.

hidden_outcome: If you also bring water from the Pure Springs, Barret gives you 'Cosmo Cannon' - an ultimate weapon attachment
